_meta.notes: PAIRED FILING - READ WITH 4478799f. This is the ORIGINAL year-end; 4478799f is Jim Bradley's AMENDMENT of the same year-end period (its cover ticks 'Yes, this is an amendment', date of report 1-31-16). The two are kept as SEPARATE records per AGENT_BRIEF s1(4); no figure from either was copied onto the other. CHUNK-FILE DISAGREEMENT: the chunk file gives seat 'At-Large C', but this FORM states no seat - the Office cell reads 'SALT LAKE COUNTY COUNCIL' and BOTH 'Office Sought' and 'District Number' are left entirely blank. The seat is an index.csv attribution, not a form fact, and cover.office_sought is '' accordingly. Political Party is written as the single letter 'D'. The Year-End (January 31) box is ticked with an X drawn across it; the amendment question is left entirely blank (neither Yes nor No), so is_amendment is ''. Column B (Aggregate Total) is blank on every Summary line - totals_to_date are '' (filer left blank), never 0. The Summary Page, Schedule A and Schedule B header boxes (Page _ of _, Last Name, Date of Report) are ALL BLANK on this filing - only the cover carries a date. Amounts are written without cents ('3,000', '$3,000'); per the currency contract a 3-digit trailing group is thousands, so these are three thousand dollars and are kept verbatim as printed. CHUNK-FILE FLAG - 'UNREDACTED contributor address cell on Schedule A' - VERIFIED PRESENT BUT BENIGN: the Complete Mailing Address cell is indeed NOT covered by the county's black bar, but what the filer wrote there is a workplace/building descriptor for the county government complex, not a street address, PO box or ZIP - there is no house number, no street name and no postal code anywhere in the cell. Nothing from that cell is reproduced in this record; donor_city/donor_state stay blank because no city or state is printed, and the row note records that the cell was left unredacted and holds a workplace descriptor. CROSS-DOCUMENT OBSERVATION (recorded, not used to set any value): this chunk's McAdams year-end 9e3ec673 lists on its own expenditure attachment '10/29/2015 | Jim Bradley for Council | Contribution | 3,000.00', the mirror image of this filing's single Schedule A row - the two filings independently record the same transfer.

contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row is 3,000 = the printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED cell '$3,000' = Summary Page line 1 Column A '3,000'. The SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell is printed but LEFT BLANK (confirmed empty in a 900 dpi crop), so only the schedule grand total and the Summary figure are available; both agree. No in-kind marker on the page.

expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row is 3,000 = Summary Page line 2 Column A '3,000'. BOTH Schedule B footer cells - SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE - are printed but LEFT BLANK (confirmed empty in a 900 dpi crop), so schedule_total is '' by the filer leaving it blank, and the Summary figure is the only anchor.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither schedule offers a page-subtotal gate: p3 SUBTOTAL blank (its TOTAL cell IS filled, $3,000, and was used instead); p4 SUBTOTAL and TOTAL both blank (gated on Summary line 2). Both blank-footer states were confirmed at 900 dpi rather than assumed from the 200 dpi page.
itemized.escalation_note: 900 dpi cell crops: p3 row-1 date/name/address group, p3 row-1 occupation+amount group (settles the struck-through occupation), p3 SUBTOTAL+TOTAL footer cells; p4 row-1 full band, p4 amount cell, p4 SUBTOTAL+TOTAL footer cells. Plus one 1200 dpi crop of the p4 recipient name and one of the p4 purpose cell to adjudicate the filer's U/V letterform (see notes).
